data.title: 贝尔法斯特 · 解下发带
data.description: 结束一天的工作后，贝尔法斯特换上缎面居家袍，在镜前解开发带。长发落下时，她伸手接住发梢。
data.promptProse: After finishing her evening duties, Belfast sits at her wooden bedroom dressing table in her belted pale silver-blue satin robe. Facing the framed vanity mirror, she slips a ribbon loose with one hand while catching the falling ends of her hair gracefully with the other. Warm bedside lamplight glows across the polished tabletop, silver brush, and her relaxed reflection.
data.animaCaption: Seated before her bedroom vanity mirror in her satin robe, Belfast slips her hair ribbon free with one hand and catches the loose ends with the other. Warm vanity lamplight softens the dark room and illuminates her calm reflection.
